summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all 21 paragraphs of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the argument, difficult assertions, negations, tests of prophets, and illustrations. The simplified edition’s sentence restructuring preserves the relevant relationships without adding doctrinal conditions. Reader-facing servant terminology and the disclosed contextual interpretation of μετανοοῦσι comply with current policy. The notes distinguish retained working readings and editorial supplements from reported witness alternatives, including earthly versus holy and the conjectured prophetic-spirit phrase. Their disclosures are compatible with the supplied bounded reports where those reports address them. Acceptance concerns fidelity to this working source and honest disclosure; it does not authenticate unseen editions or manuscript handwriting, verify every reported witness detail, or certify exhaustive collation.
